title: Qwen3.8 27B on Hugging Face
evidence: Measured on Hugging Face 28 Oct 2026 (C1), seeded data: 90 rows, 69 steps on a100-large (NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB): 6,248 s billed (105 min, $4.38); peak 31.2 GB of 80 GB; validation loss per pass 0.544, 0.568, 0.588 (finite); 3 passes exported to Q4_K_M GGUF in the job (2,607 s); downloaded, checked and served here in Row-Bot's own server (probe and a real tool turn). The L40S alternative is an estimate (1.5x the A100's time a step), not measured.
